title: event.deviceidentity.cert-issued.v1.payload
description: Metadata-only notification: a device certificate was issued. Consumers MUST refetch via the status endpoint to obtain current certificate state. No certificate body or key material is carried on the bus.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier; omitted for single-tenant deployments

epoch.description: Monotonic renewal epoch; 0 for initial enrollment

action.description: Issuance action: enrolled (first certificate) or renewed (rotation)

actorId.description: Principal ID of the actor who triggered issuance
